t: Gross domestic product (GDP) | Definition & Formula | Britannica Money
s: In economics, the final users of goods and services are divided into three main groups: households, businesses, and the government. One way gross domestic product (GDP) is calculated—known as the expenditure approach—is by adding the expenditures made by those three groups of users.
